company.shortDescription: Fomo is a mobile-first crypto trading and social investing platform that lets users buy, track, and trade crypto assets.
company.description: Fomo is a mobile-first crypto trading and social investing platform that lets users buy, track, and trade crypto assets within a single integrated app. It focuses on simplifying crypto access by combining wallet setup, trading, and discovery features in one interface, rather than requiring users to move between exchanges, wallets, and analytics tools. The platform is designed around social trading and token discovery, where users can follow other traders, view what they are buying, and potentially copy their trades directly. It also emphasizes early discovery of trending tokens, giving users visibility into new or emerging assets before they gain wider market attention.
